raw_text: Okay, then a requirement is that there has to be a real domain to be configured for that app before analytics can be enabled. Else you never can derive the correct proxy route, which is analytics.maelou.app in this case.

expectation: Require a configured app domain before analytics enable mutates state

protection.rejected_example: An app without a domain enables analytics
protection.accepted_example: An app without a domain returns analytics.domain_required before mutation
